user.title: Appliance Cycle
user.description: Choose the sensor measuring the power drawn by the appliance (for example a smart plug).

data_description.name: For example “Dishwasher”.
data_description.power_sensor: Sensor in watts, updated at least every few seconds while running.
data_description.appliance: Sets the initial detection thresholds; you can change them in the options.

abort.already_configured: This power sensor is already used.

data_description.notify_services: Notify services that receive a message when the cycle ends (for example notify.mobile_app_phone).
data_description.notify_before: Minutes before the estimated end to send a reminder (0 = none).
data_description.finished_timeout: After how many minutes the status goes back from “finished” to “idle” (0 = stays finished).

data_description.idle_power: Up to this power the appliance is considered off.
data_description.start_power: A cycle only counts once the power reaches this value (heater or motor); weaker activity, like the display or the door opening, is ignored.
data_description.end_delay: The cycle has ended when the power stays idle for this long.

unknown_appliance.message: The entity does not belong to an Appliance Cycle appliance.

no_cycle.message: No cycle has been recorded yet.
